@survicate/react-native-survicate 4.3.0 (npm)

The npm package publishes no license text. Its package.json declares the license "MIT" (package.json also names "licenseFilename": "LICENSE", a file the published package does not contain; the repository named in package.json, github.com/Survicate/survicate-react-native-sdk, has no LICENSE file at its default branch either).
The text below is the SPDX standard text of MIT (https://github.com/spdx/license-list-data, tag v3.25.0), not a text written by the lab; its <year> and <copyright holders> / <owner> fields are SPDX's own placeholders and are left as they are.

Only the generated codegen C++ of the package's TypeScript spec is compiled by the lab; none of the package's native implementation and none of the proprietary Survicate native SDK (com.survicate:survicate-sdk) is used.
